definitions: T5 conditions (100 Hz, 0.2 layer/pulse, 1200 K, spike 150 K / 30 us), Al (E_edge, E_S, E_ES) = (0.6, 1.8, 0.01) eV, grid 300, 1000 layers, seeds 2000-2002. beta_w*: surface-width beta in the layer windows 200-400, 400-700, 700-1000 (cell median); vac_w*: buried vacancy fraction of those levels in the final film; excess: dopant pair excess against random relabelling, excess_sd its relabelling SD; cluster_ln_ratio: [median, CI lo, CI hi, verdict] of ln(mean cluster size / neutral). f3: packed crops (C-order i, j, k; numpy packbits; base64) of the top 30 levels of 48 x 48 columns, z_lo their lowest level; top: 150 x 150 surface-envelope heights minus `min` (uint8, row-major i * size + j) and packed bits 'the column's top atom is a dopant'. cn: per layer window (pulses after 100, 500, 950 layers), mean over 5 pulses of the gas and the Al / dopant counts with CN 0-4 at t after the pulse (s).
source: outputs/studies/2026-11_t10 (tables of git show 895e7eb:sapphire_kMC_simulation/scripts/t10_analysis.py; seed-2000 f 0.03 runs); docs/notebook/2026-11-10-t10-long-runs.md
caveats: Energetic parameters are placeholders, so absolute island densities, diffusion lengths and terrace widths are not quantitative (CLAUDE.md POLICY). Only trends across a sweep are usable.
The beta classes and the W pass mark (w_j < 1) are repo-defined thresholds; W_early of the T1 points and the tanh rms over the transition window are post hoc.
